description: This file contains helper functions and utilities for system services, including error handling, file operations, string manipulations, system information retrieval, and network operations, used within the RDK framework.

methods.name: getErrorDescription
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string for a given error code based on a predefined map.

methods.name: dirnameOf
methods.description: Extracts the directory path from a full filename.

methods.name: dirExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at the specified path.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads the first line of a file into a string.

methods.name: populateResponseWithError
methods.description: Populates a JSON response object with error status and message.

methods.name: caseInsensitive
methods.description: Extracts model information from a string, case-insensitively.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Removes trailing whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes both leading and trailing whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves device model information by executing a shell script.

methods.name: convertCase
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Checks if a firmware string contains a specific substring, case-insensitively.

methods.name: setJSONResponseArray
methods.description: Constructs a JSON array from a vector of strings and adds it to a JSON response.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Reads entire file content into a string or vector of strings.

methods.name: searchAndGetFilesList
methods.description: Searches for files in a directory matching a filter and returns a list of filenames.

methods.name: strcicmp
methods.description: Performs case-insensitive comparison of two C strings.

methods.name: findCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a substring, case-insensitively.

methods.name: getXconfOverrideUrl
methods.description: Retrieves override URL from configuration file if present.

methods.name: getTimeZoneDSTHelper
methods.description: Reads timezone information from a file.

methods.name: getTimeZoneAccuracyDSTHelper
methods.description: Reads timezone accuracy info from a file, defaults if invalid.

methods.name: currentDateTimeUtc
methods.description: Returns current UTC date/time formatted string.

methods.name: url_encode
methods.description: Encodes a URL string using libcurl.

methods.name: urlEncodeField
methods.description: Encodes a string for URL transmission using a curl handle.

methods.name: writeCurlResponse
methods.description: Handles data received from curl and appends to a string stream.

methods.name: findMacInString
methods.description: Extracts MAC address from a string based on a key.

methods.name: enableXREConnectionRetentionHelper
methods.description: Creates or removes a retention status file based on enable flag.

methods.name: stringTodate
methods.description: Converts a date string to a formatted string with UTC timezone.

methods.name: removeCharsFromString
methods.description: Removes specified characters from a string.

methods.name: curl_write
methods.description: Curl write callback function for data transfer.

methods.name: parseConfigFile
methods.description: Parses a configuration file to find a key's value.
